No, it's not okay.
If I use this, there's no going back.
I already know that I'm going to disappear.
Still, as long as I have my life, I need to find another way.

page1.text:
I made a promise to protect Sakura from everything.
I can't allow my life to be snuffed out so easily.
I want to Sakura to live—I want to live with Sakura.
So, I still...

page3.text:
...But there's no other way.
Sakura's sins. Destroying this curse is the absolute condition to let her be happy.

page4.text:
...My mind is down to a few grains of sand.
Sakura, I...
"Begin Projection."
...will keep my...

"—"
A sword in my hand.
With—body—can't—last—

page6.text:
No, Shirou. You won't die.
After all, it's my job to close the door.

page7.text:
"—"
That's...
Someone's voice. I can't remember her name.

page8.text:
"— — —, —?"
I say her name, even though I can't remember it.
I feel that I have to say it.
If I don't, — will never come home.

page9.text:
Hey.
Do you want to live, Shirou? Do you want to keep living, no matter what life you lead, or what shape you're in?

page10.text:
"—, —"
I want to live. What's her name? I have to say her name and stop her.
But I want to live. I know — will disappear if I nod, what's her name, I wish from the bottom of my heart to live.

page11.text:
Okay.
Good. I was hoping you'd say that. I want you to live more than me.

page12.text:
"—, —"
What are you talking about, idiot?
Just come back. If you go any further, you won't be able to.
I'll take that thing down with me, so, damn it, what's your name, I have to remember your name, it's precious, I'm turning so dumb, your name...

page13.text:
Then I'll show you a miracle.
Last time, I showed you how to see far away with magecraft, but this time, it'll be really amazing!
This is the Magic everyone wishes they could see.

page14.text:
—, —ya."
Don't do it. You don't have to show me. Just come back.
I...

page15.text:
Sadly, the vessel is lacking.
We only have my body to use, so I can't completely recreate it. It'll be okay, though. If you do some trial and error with Rin, I'm sure you can go back to normal.

page16.text:
"—, —ya...!"
She moves into the middle.
Someone in a white dress becomes a sacrificial key and closes the Greater Grail, just like the very first ritual.

page17.text:
—Bye.
We aren't related by blood,
but I'm really glad that we're siblings.

page18.text:
...
—lya.
Don't go. If you care about me, don't go.
I can't sacrifice you. I said we'd live together, that I'd make up for all the time you spent alone.
But...but if someone's going to be a sacrifice then it should be—

page19.text:
No.
You said a big brother's supposed to protect his sister, remember?
...Yeah. Well, I'm your big sister. So I have to protect my little brother.

page20.text:
"I—lya."
I remember.
Her name.
Kiritsugu's real blood relative. The little girl whom I replaced, leaving her all alone.
She's a girl with red eyes and silver hair, a little older than me—

page21.text:
"Illya... Illya, Illya, Illya, Illya, Illya!!!"
I can't reach her.
She can't hear my voice.
I'm bathed in light and I can't see.
At the end, she...

page22.text: She said goodbye, smiled, and shut the door to the Greater Grail.

page24.text: For just a moment, I lift my arm up and reach into the sky.

page25.text:
But nothing is left.
There isn't a single bit of power left in this body.

page26.text:
I'm sinking.
The life she saved is sinking.

page27.text:
I clench my fist in frustration.
There's cold pain in the palm of my hand.
It awakens my sinking mind.

page28.text: "It's okay. Rin will come for you."

page29.text:
Yeah.
There's a tiny miracle in the palm of my hand.
One breath of magical energy.
It's completely useless, but the small, small pendant will make sure that someone saves me if I reach out with my hand.

page30.text:
I reach out.
I feel soft air and warm sunshine on my skin.
